issues.description: Extraction requires a story manifest and story files, but the repo commits no source stories, so demo/full extraction cannot run.
The end-to-end test depends on missing repository data and currently fails with FileNotFoundError.
Checked-in artifacts reference source topics/manifests that are not committed, making outputs unauditable and non-regenerable.
Tiny extraction injects the ground-truth emotion label into activations, making demo validation partly tautological.
Empty story sets crash via unguarded min/max calls instead of producing a clear configuration error.
Vector artifacts are loaded without validating manifest/backend/layer/dimension compatibility, causing raw numpy shape crashes.
No guard exists for manifests whose emotions have no matching scenarios, causing np.stack to fail.
Preference validation also trusts vector artifact shape and manifest contents without compatibility checks.
HuggingFace tokenizer/model downloads are unpinned by revision, so results and supply-chain surface can change over time.
Preference scoring uses a single-activity good-vs-bad logit rather than an actual pairwise preference prompt as documented.
The configured steering.min_reported_emotions value is ignored in favor of a hard-coded four-emotion fallback.
Dependencies use only lower bounds and no lock/constraints file, reducing reproducibility for a numerical pipeline.
